reforms.description: The establishment of the Council for Science and Technology Policy aims to increase emphasis on basic research and improve the efficiency of public technology spending, while the new defined contribution system for corporate pension funds allows firms and self-employed individuals to enjoy favorable tax treatment, enhancing financial stability and encouraging investment in innovative sectors.
reforms.component_name: Public R&D Funding and Corporate Pension Reform
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Enhancing public R&D funding and encouraging private investment in innovation are expected to raise productivity and innovation capacity.
reforms.status_evidence: Both reforms have been implemented as of 2001.
reforms.importance_rationale: The reforms represent significant structural changes in public R&D funding and corporate investment incentives.
reforms.source_quote: The new defined contribution system... is available not only for employees but also for self-employed.

reforms.description: The introduction of fixed-term rental contracts for houses is expected to stimulate the supply of rental houses by allowing flexible rental terms, which could enhance mobility and indirectly support innovation by improving housing market efficiency.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Improving housing market efficiency can enhance mobility, which is beneficial for innovation.
reforms.status_evidence: The reform has been implemented as of 2000.
reforms.importance_rationale: While not a major reform, it represents a significant change in housing policy that can support innovation indirectly.
reforms.source_quote: A new law allowing genuine fixed-term rental contracts for houses was introduced in March 2000.

reforms.description: The revised patent law allows patent attorneys to play a greater role in the trade of intellectual property rights, enhancing the protection and commercialization of innovations.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Enhancing intellectual property protection is expected to facilitate innovation commercialization and increase investment in R&D.
reforms.status_evidence: The reform has been implemented as of 2001.
reforms.importance_rationale: The revision of patent law is significant for improving the commercialization of innovations but does not represent a structural change.
reforms.source_quote: Revised law for patent attorney in force since January 2001.

reforms.description: Three competing venture security markets were established to encourage more start-ups and venture business operations, aiming to enhance the startup ecosystem.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Encouraging start-ups and venture businesses is expected to foster innovation and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The reform has been implemented as of 2001.
reforms.importance_rationale: The establishment of venture security markets is significant for supporting start-ups but does not represent a major overhaul of the system.
reforms.source_quote: Three competing venture security markets now in full operation.
